{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'new' customer segment is not present in data"
assert 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique(), "'paid_search' channel is not present in data"
assert df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "'converted' column contains values other than 0 and 1"

# Count QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
num_qa_orders = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = '999999.99'): {num_qa_orders}")

# Count refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered = df_clean[
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute conversion fraction
if len(filtered) == 0:
    conversion_fraction = 0.0
else:
    conversion_fraction = filtered['converted'].mean()

print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid search: {len(filtered)}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Print final value
conversion_fraction"}
